core_statement: In the heavy-isotropic rank-three form Q=2B(sqrt(c)Xi+T)Y+rY^2+2sYZ+tau Z^2, if the residual transverse Parseval rows w_j=(y_j,z_j) obey ||w_j||^2<=1/2, arbitrary leakage modulation preserves a uniform two-dimensional Wiener bound. This yields |phi_Q(t)| <= e^(1/2)pi^(3/4)[cB^2|tau|]^(-1/4)|t|^(-3/4), an L2 density norm <=sqrt(3)e^(1/3)[cB^2|tau|]^(-1/6), and half-Riesz potential <=6sqrt(2)e^(1/3)[cB^2|tau|]^(-1/6).
